attributes.description:
Dataview for event id 4688: Process Creation

Event 4688 documents each program that is executed, who the program ran as and the process that started this process.

When you start a program you are creating a "process" that stays open until the program exits.  This process is identified by the Process ID:.  You can correlate this event to other events by Process ID to determine what the program did while it ran and when it exited (event 4689).

Win2012R2 adds Process Command Line.
attributes.title: WAPP_EVTX_4688

attributes.description:
Evtx 4672 Special Logon Dataview: 

This event lets you know whenever an account assigned any "administrator equivalent" user rights logs on.  For instance you will see event 4672 in close proximity to logon events (4624) for administrators since administrators have most of these admin-equivalent rights.
attributes.title: WAPP_EVTX_4672

attributes.description:
DataView for event id 7045 : New Service created

A new service was installed by the user indicated in the subject. Subject often identifies the local system (SYSTEM) for services installed as part of native Windows components and therefore you can't determine who actually initiated the installation

attributes.description:
Event id 4648 Dataview:

This event is generated when a process attempts an account logon by explicitly specifying that account’s credentials.

This most commonly occurs in batch-type configurations such as scheduled tasks, or when using the “RUNAS” command.

It is also a routine event which periodically occurs during normal operating system activity.
